messages.author: 5063fec87cce1b2f
messages.subject: App deploys successfully but I get "ERROR: cannot open the connection"
parts:
I think Shiny is a great platform and look forward to using it quite a bit in the future.  I've deployed two apps thus far (just testing everything out) but today when I tried to deploy an app that runs successfully locally, I get "ERROR: cannot open the connection" after the app is deployed.

I can't tell what's wrong: everything is in the working directory, including the sourced function and I received no errors during deployment. Output from deployApp() is:

> deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 19458...
Waiting for task: 1407047
  building: Building image: 48851
  building: Installing packages
  building: Installing files
  building: Pushing image: 48851
  deploying: Starting instances
  rollforward: Activating new instances
  terminating: Stopping old instances
Application successfully deployed to http://stevenranney.shinyapps.io/craps

The address is stevenranney.shinyapps.io/craps

Any help?  This is mostly a learning exercise for me so not truly important in the grand scheme of things but I'm curious as to why it's not deploying successfully.

Thanks - 

SR

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] App deploys successfully but I get "ERROR: cannot open the connection"
parts:
Hi Steven,
Glad you are looking at Shiny, hopefully we can get this issue resolved for you quickly.  Without visibility into the code or the error log, it is hard to guess at exactly what is going on, but I suspect your application is trying to open a connection to a resource that is either not bundled in with the application, or perhaps is behind a firewall.  
Would you mind sharing the output of showLogs() with us?

Thanks,
Tareef

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] App deploys successfully but I get "ERROR: cannot open the connection"
parts:
Tareef - 

Thanks for the tip on the showLogs() function.  I discovered I had an issue with the naming of an external function.  It was a ".r" vs. ".R" issue and Shiny couldn't find the function with the ".r" extension.  After the change, the app deployed and is working successfully.

Thanks for the tip.  Again, the app is working successfully now.

SR

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] App deploys successfully but I get "ERROR: cannot open the connection"
parts:
Steven.

I am glad it's working. ShinyApps servers run Linux which uses a case-sensitive file system. Users on Mac OSX (and Windows I believe) may run into issues like this. We should perhaps put this in the documentation. 

-Andy
